property_summary: For any caller, if transferOwnership is called, the owner after the call must either remain unchanged (revert) or equal the argument (success), but the bug lets a non-owner succeed while still setting owner to the new owner, violating the invariant that only the current owner can change ownership to any different address.
change_summary: Change the require condition to always pass (true), removing the sender check so anyone can call transferOwnership.
